sources.title: Surfnerd spot guide: Pickens Point Dunes

notes: surfnerd pin 0.0 km from ours. surfnerd gives no workable swell ("Unknown") and no break notes; its swell-exposure compass (E - W) is not a stated window for this break (it follows the facing), so no window is recorded. surfnerd lists its workable wind as offshore from S, which is onshore for its own SSE facing (its wind-exposure compass agrees with the facing); this page is low-confidence.

surfnerd pin 0.1 km from ours. surfnerd gives no workable swell ("Unknown") and no break notes; its swell-exposure compass (E - WSW) is not a stated window for this break (it follows the facing), so no window is recorded. surfnerd lists its workable wind as offshore from S, which is onshore for its own SE facing (its wind-exposure compass agrees with the facing); this page is low-confidence.
